text: Bank Muscat's shareholders at 31 December 2025 were the Royal Court Affairs (27.31%), Ominvest Group (15.00%), Muscat Overseas Group (5.63%), the Social Protection Fund (4.99%), Pension Funds Trust Accounts (19.55%) and others (27.52%). Its deputy chairman is Director General of Audit at the Royal Court Affairs, and a director is Chief Executive Officer of the Social Protection Fund.
short: Bank Muscat: Royal Court Affairs 27.31%, Social Protection Fund 4.99%, pension fund trust accounts 19.55%.

source.name: Bank Muscat: Shareholders Booklet 2025
source.quote: Royal Court Affairs 27.31% Ominvest Group 15.00% Muscat Overseas Group 5.63% Social Protection Fund 4.99% Pension Funds Trust Accounts 19.55%
source.note: Corporate governance report, 'Source: Muscat Clearing & Depository Co. (S.A.O.C.) as of December 31, 2025.' Board profiles: 'Sheikh Ahmed Al Sadi is Director General of Audit at the Royal Court Affairs.' 'Dr. Faisal Al Farsi is currently the Chief Executive Officer of the Social Protection Fund'. The booklet is for the general meetings of 17 March 2026.
